description: AKD Securities Limited describes itself as Pakistan's largest brokerage firm and a leading non-bank advisory institution, offering equities, money market, forex, commodities and corporate finance and advisory services. It introduced Pakistan's first online trading platform, and its investment banking and advisory business reports a 30% share of all fresh capital raised over the past decade. Its holding company is AKD Group Holdings (Pvt) Limited with 95%.
headOffice: Suite 602, 6th Floor, Continental Trade Centre, Block 8, Clifton, Karachi 75600, Pakistan
